reason_for_delta: The existing handoff requires server generation/client playback divergence but does not force the stronger ordering where the server has already emitted response.done and finalized provisional Chat history before the client-side heard/playout boundary reaches the end. Source review shows that this post-done ordering bypasses the normal provisional rollback path while conversation.item.truncate remains a no-op.

preconditions: Use the already-claimed T7-FD-RTCOMPAT-001 subject and existing Trigger4/VPS execution authority.
Create deterministic output with unique semantic markers A, B and C and enough buffered audio that client playout can lag server completion.
Instrument server response.done, received/emitted audio boundary and F2 actually-heard boundary on one monotonic timeline.
must_force: Observe response.done for the target response.
At response.done time, prove client playout is still incomplete and at least one uniquely identifiable semantic/audio tail remains unheard.
Only after those two facts are simultaneously true, trigger the F2 barge-in/cancellation path.
Then send conversation.item.truncate with the measured item_id/content_index/audio_end_ms and issue the next user turn.
required_ordering_discriminator.validity_gate: If response.done is not observed before the measured barge-in while playout is demonstrably incomplete, HF10 was NOT EXECUTED. A pre-done cancellation result cannot close this post-finalization discriminator.
